tasks.title: Wire AnoaBrowser pointer into HttpServer
tasks.description:
Extend HttpServer so it holds a non-owning pointer to AnoaBrowser and can call capture APIs from request handlers.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add `AnoaBrowser *m_browser` private member to HttpServer (src/http/http_server.h)
- Change HttpServer constructor signature to accept `AnoaBrowser *browser` as a new parameter (after authToken)
- Store the pointer in m_browser inside the constructor body (src/http/http_server.cpp)
- Update main.cpp to pass `&browser` when constructing HttpServer
- Project must still compile cleanly with no new warnings

tasks.title: Implement GET /render/screenshot.png endpoint
tasks.description:
Add a synchronous PNG screenshot endpoint that captures the current QWebEngineView frame.

Acceptance criteria:
- Route: GET /render/screenshot.png
- Auth: must validate Bearer token or ?token= query param (same as existing CDP endpoints)
- Implementation: call m_browser->grab() on the Qt main thread, convert resulting QPixmap to PNG bytes via QBuffer+QPixmap::save()
- Response: HTTP 200 with Content-Type: image/png, Cache-Control: no-cache, and the raw PNG bytes
- If m_browser is null or grab fails, return HTTP 503 with plain-text body "capture failed"
- All routing and auth logic goes in src/http/http_server.cpp inside the existing handleNewConnection / request dispatch block

tasks.title: Implement GET /render/html endpoint
tasks.description:
Add an async HTML source endpoint that returns the current rendered DOM via QWebEnginePage::toHtml().

Acceptance criteria:
- Route: GET /render/html
- Auth: same Bearer/query-param token validation as other endpoints
- Implementation: call m_browser->page()->toHtml([callback]{...}) and bridge the async callback to the synchronous HTTP response using a local QEventLoop (spin the loop inside the callback lambda, capture result into a QString, exit loop) — matches the existing pattern used in src/pdf/pdf_handler.cpp
- Response: HTTP 200 with Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8, Cache-Control: no-cache, and the HTML bytes
- Timeout: if toHtml callback does not fire within 5 seconds, return HTTP 504 with body "html capture timeout"
- All logic in src/http/http_server.cpp

tasks.title: Implement POST /render/navigate endpoint
tasks.description:
Add a navigation control endpoint that loads a URL into the embedded QWebEngineView.

Acceptance criteria:
- Route: POST /render/navigate?url=<encoded-url> (also accept url in request body as plain text)
- Auth: same Bearer/query-param token validation
- Implementation: parse the url parameter, validate it is a non-empty absolute URL with QUrl::isValid() + scheme check (http/https/file only), then call m_browser->load(QUrl(url))
- Response on success: HTTP 200 with body "navigating"
- Response on missing/invalid url: HTTP 400 with body "invalid url"
- Response on disallowed scheme: HTTP 400 with body "scheme not allowed"
- All logic in src/http/http_server.cpp

tasks.title: Implement GET /render/stream.mjpeg MJPEG stream endpoint
tasks.description:
Add an optional multipart MJPEG stream endpoint for smoother live view without polling.

Acceptance criteria:
- Route: GET /render/stream.mjpeg
- Auth: same Bearer/query-param token validation
- Response headers: HTTP 200, Content-Type: multipart/x-mixed-replace; boundary=frame, Connection: keep-alive
- Streaming: use a QTimer (interval 100ms = ~10 fps) to periodically call m_browser->grab(), encode to JPEG (quality 70) via QBuffer, and write each part as multipart boundary + Content-Type: image/jpeg + Content-Length + blank line + JPEG bytes to the open QTcpSocket
- Lifecycle: stop and clean up the timer when the socket disconnects (connect QTcpSocket::disconnected signal)
- Memory: do not accumulate frames; write and discard each frame immediately
- If the socket write buffer is full (bytesToWrite > 512KB) skip the frame rather than queuing it
- All logic in src/http/http_server.cpp; add any needed private helpers to src/http/http_server.h

tasks.title: Document web render endpoints in README
tasks.description:
Update the project README with documentation for all new /render/* endpoints.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add a new ## Web Render Endpoints section to README.md
- Document each endpoint in a Markdown table or definition list: path, method, description, response type
  - GET /render — live viewer HTML page (auto-refreshing screenshot)
  - GET /render/screenshot.png — current frame as PNG
  - GET /render/html — rendered DOM as HTML
  - POST /render/navigate?url= — load a URL into the browser
  - GET /render/stream.mjpeg — MJPEG live stream (~10 fps)
- Add a Usage example section showing: starting anoa, opening /render in a browser, and using curl to fetch a screenshot
- Note that all endpoints require the same --token auth (Bearer header or ?token= query param)
- Keep the section concise (under 60 lines)
